changelog.text:
### New
- You can now open video files directly from other apps in the Sv family.
- Voice-over generation is now faster by automatically reusing previously created audio clips.
### Improved
- Translation is now more reliable and handles busy periods much more smoothly.
- The app now checks if your voice-over components are up to date to ensure the best performance.
- Processing of long videos is more stable and efficient.
### Fixed
- Fixed issues where the voice-over service would occasionally time out or stall.
- Improved how the app handles foreign names during translation.

### New
- Added a built-in video downloader to easily grab videos from YouTube, TikTok, and other sites (Pro).
- Added "SvCamTool AI" mode, allowing you to use Gemini without needing your own API key.
- Added support for child voices (young boy, young girl, and kid) for more natural dubbing.
- Added a new System Check tool in the Help menu to quickly verify your connection and services.
- Added over 100 new professional thumbnail styles and episode badge support (Pro).
### Improved
- Improved translation reliability by automatically handling busy AI keys more effectively.
- You can now highlight specific words in your thumbnail titles with custom colors and sizes.
- Voice-over generation is now faster and more reliable with improved caching.
- Added support to open video files directly from other Sv apps.

### New
- Built-in Video Downloader to grab single videos, full channels, or playlists from YouTube, TikTok, Facebook, and over 1,000 sites (Pro).
- Automatic child voice detection with new young boy, young girl, and kid dubbing voices that use child-friendly Khmer phrasing.
- SvCamTool AI connection that lets you translate and detect voices without needing your own Gemini key.
- Expanded Thumbnail Maker with over 100 ready-to-use title styles, word highlighting, and customizable episode badges.
- System Check tool in the Help menu to instantly test your internet, AI keys, and voice services for issues.
### Improved
- Title style previews in the Thumbnail Maker now show your actual text instead of generic placeholder letters.
- Token tracker under Help > My AI Tokens to easily monitor your monthly usage when using SvCamTool AI.

### New
- Added SvCamTool AI: translate with Gemini directly through your license plan—no personal Gemini API key required.
- Added support for new young voices (Young Boy, Young Girl, Kid) with automatic age detection for children's lines.
- Added System Check under the Help menu to test your internet, license, AI keys, and voice services in one click.
- Added automated creator tools to create Shorts/Reels, keep original voice clones, add background music, auto-zoom key moments, and publish packs (Premium).
- Added multi-language rendering to translate and render a single video into several target languages in one run (Premium).
- Added a video downloader tool to grab individual videos, playlists, or entire channels from over 1,000 supported sites (Professional & Premium).
### Improved
- Upgraded recap video tools with smart section splitting, sentence snapping, smooth transitions, vertical 9:16 layout, and animated title overlays.
- Upgraded the progress bar during transcription, translation, and rendering to give smoother and more accurate timing estimates.
- Updated Telegram contact support to @SvCamTool.
- Added animated caption text effects, including continuous scrolling up, down, and across the screen.
### Fixed
- Fixed an issue where saved lines using the same voice were not automatically updated when switching to Auto voice.
- Fixed JSON parsing errors that could occur during recap generation.

### New
- Added a new **Premium** plan featuring advanced creator tools [Premium].
- Added animated word-by-word captions (karaoke and pop-up styles) [Premium].
- Added automatic punch-in zoom effects on key lines [Premium].
- Added background music support with automatic volume ducking when someone speaks [Premium].
- Added voice cloning to let each character keep a clone of their original voice [Premium].
- Added multi-language export to translate and render a video into several languages in one run [Premium].
- Added automatic Shorts/Reels/TikTok clipping and watch folder support [Premium].
### Improved
- Upgraded the payment screen layout with clear instructions and a built-in timer.
- Improved progress reporting during FFmpeg rendering and audio processing.

### New
- Added AI picture generation for thumbnails using Grok (xAI) or ChatGPT (OpenAI) with your own API key (Trial)
- Added creator tools for Pro and Premium plans, including automated punch-in zooms, character voice cloning, and AI Shorts clipping (Pro)
- Added text animations with intro, outro, and loop effects in the video editor (Pro)
- Added background music support with automatic ducking during voice-overs (Pro)
### Improved
- Improved progress tracking during video rendering and audio extraction
- Improved speaker voice recognition and gender detection accuracy
- Enhanced temporary file management to automatically clean up old data
### Fixed
- Fixed an issue where unfinished temporary audio files could result in incomplete videos
- Fixed JSON parsing errors in AI recap generation

### New
- **AI Thumbnail Pictures**: Generate custom picture backgrounds for video thumbnails using Grok (xAI) or ChatGPT (OpenAI) with your own API key.
- **Narrated Video Recaps**: Create a short, narrated summary story of a longer video (drama or film recap) with professional tools.
- **Text Animations**: Add entrance, exit, and loop animations to on-screen text in the video editor [Pro].
- **Speaker Recognition**: Identify different speakers in your videos automatically to assign voices more accurately [Pro].
- **Quick Video Previews**: Test your edits and animations instantly with a fast, short preview before rendering the full video.
### Improved
- **Faster Speech Recognition**: Gemini can now listen to long videos in parallel chunks for significantly faster transcription on videos without NVIDIA graphics cards.
- **Foreign Name Spelling**: Automatically corrects the spelling of names left in Chinese, Japanese, or Korean characters so the voice-over can read them.
- **Work Folder Location**: Temporary video project files are now kept neatly in the app's own data folder rather than next to your original videos.
- **Reliable Voice Checks**: Voice gender checks now include automatic retry steps and wait times to handle rate limits smoothly.
### Fixed
- **Empty Output Prevention**: Added safeguards to detect and fix damaged temporary sound files that previously caused finished videos to export empty or too short.
- **Video Cutter Sync**: Fixed an issue where audio and video could drift out of sync when cutting specific segments.

### New
- Added AI picture generation for thumbnails using Grok (xAI) or ChatGPT (OpenAI) with your own API key (Pro).
- Added text animations including intro, outro, and loop effects for custom text layers (Pro).
- Added an extra small title layer (third text layer) for thumbnail creation.
- Added advanced speaker recognition to automatically group speakers by voice print for more accurate gender detection.
### Improved
- Improved video rendering speed and overall performance when applying multiple visual effects.
- Improved handling of Gemini free-plan limits with automatic waiting and retries.
- Enhanced gender detection reliability using voice timbre analysis alongside pitch detection.
### Fixed
- Fixed an issue where interrupted runs or damaged temporary audio files could result in incomplete videos.

### New
- Added support for creating narrated recap videos with AI hooks and custom lengths (Pro).
### Improved
- Made speech recognition faster by listening to audio in parallel parts.
- Automatically transliterates and spells any remaining foreign letters into the target language.
### Fixed
- Fixed text translation issues for foreign character sets.

### New
- Added support for translating and dubbing videos into English, Thai, and Vietnamese in addition to Khmer.
- Added a new professional narrated recap video feature with AI hooks and custom lengths (Pro).
### Improved
- Improved line breaking and word handling for non-Khmer target languages.
- Updated default subtitle font settings for better compatibility.
### Fixed
- Fixed an issue with spelling foreign names during translation.

### New
- Added support for translating and creating voice-overs in English, Thai, and Vietnamese in addition to Khmer.
- Added a display language option in the View menu to switch the app interface between English, Khmer, Thai, and Vietnamese.
- Added Payment Terms and Conditions which must be agreed to when purchasing a license.
### Improved
- Updated font handling and fallbacks for better display of Khmer, Thai, and Vietnamese text across the app.
- Improved dubbing translation prompts to ensure natural phrasing and correct pronouns for each supported target language.

### New
- Added support for translating and dubbing videos into English, Thai, and Vietnamese in addition to Khmer.
- Added an app display language option for English, Khmer, Thai, and Vietnamese.
- Added manual KHQR payment options for buying and renewing license plans.
### Improved
- Updated font selection to automatically show only fonts containing the letters of your chosen target language.
- Improved license check notifications and handling when a license key is removed by the admin.
- Updated shortcuts and branding references from SV Dubber to SvCamTool.
### Fixed
- Fixed text spacing and line-breaking rules for non-Khmer target languages.

### New
- Added a manual payment option with the admin's KHQR codes (ABA and ACLEDA) for customers who prefer to pay manually.
- Added a "Contact admin" button directly on the plan selection screen to easily get help or pay by cash/bank transfer.
### Improved
- Renamed the application from "SV Dubber" to "SvCamTool" across all windows, shortcuts, and watermarks.
- Redesigned the contact and payment screens to be cleaner, removing icons and standardizing button sizes.
- Replaced various icon buttons (like trash bins and reset arrows) with clear text buttons like "Delete" and "Reset".
- Moved license status updates and offline warnings to the status bar to keep the main job log clean.
- Improved license management so that if an active license key is removed by the admin, the app lets you enter a new key or choose a plan instead of immediately closing.
### Fixed
- Fixed shortcut renaming and launching issues for users upgrading from older versions (including "Khmer Dub Studio" and "SV Dubber").

### Improved
- Renamed the application from "SV Dubber" to "SvCamTool" across all shortcuts, windows, and menus.
- Added a manual payment option using the admin's KHQR code (ABA or ACLEDA Bank) for cash or bank transfers.
- Improved the layout on smaller screens to prevent the video preview from covering the playback buttons.
- Simplified the user interface by removing several icons from buttons and contact details.
- Moved license status updates and offline warnings to the status bar to keep the main job log clean.
### Fixed
- Fixed an issue where a blocked or deleted license key would prevent the app from opening; it now correctly redirects to the plan selection screen.

### Improved
- Improvements and bug fixes.

### Improved
- Improved the license activation system to support newly issued license keys.

### Improved
- Updated our licensing system to support new license keys and ensure smoother activation.

### Improved
- Faster and more reliable license server connection on networks with slow IPv6 routing.
- License verification timeouts and error messages have been improved for better stability.

### Improved
- License activation and verification are now much faster and more reliable, especially on internet connections with IPv6 issues.
- Connection timeouts have been increased to prevent license sync failures on slower internet connections.
- The system log now provides clearer error details if the license server cannot be reached.

### Improved
- Increased the connection timeout when syncing licenses to prevent errors on slower internet connections.
- Offline-generated license keys are now protected from being automatically overwritten by lower-tier plans.
- License connection errors are now displayed in the main app log to make troubleshooting easier.
### Fixed
- Fixed connection timeouts during license activation on network routers with broken IPv6 configurations.

### ថ្មី
- ឥឡូវนี้អ្នកអាចបើកឯកសារវីដេអូដោយផ្ទាល់ពីកម្មវិធីផ្សេងទៀតនៅក្នុងគ្រួសារ Sv។
- ការបង្កើតសំឡេងអរូបី (Voice-over) ឥឡូវនេះលឿនជាងមុន ដោយការប្រើប្រាស់ឡើងវិញដោយស្វ័យប្រវត្តិូវឃ្លីបសំឡេងដែលបានបង្កើតពីមុន។
### បានកែលម្អ
- ការបកប្រែឥឡូវនេះមានភាពជឿជាក់ជាងមុន និងគ្រប់គ្រងពេលមានការមមាញឹកបានយ៉ាងរលូន។
- ឥឡូវនេះកម្មវិធីពិនិត្យមើលថាតើសមាសធាតុសំឡេងរបស់អ្នកទាន់សម័យឬអត់ ដើម្បីធានាបាននូវដំណើរការល្អបំផុត។
- ការដំណើរការវីដេអូខ្នាតវែងមានភាពនឹងនរ និងមានប្រសិទ្ធភាពជាងមុន។
### បានជួសជុល
- បានជួសជុលបញ្ហាដែលសេវាកម្មសំឡេងអរូបីពេលខ្លះអស់ពេល (Time out) ឬគាំង។
- បានកែលម្អវិធីដែលកម្មវិធីគ្រប់គ្រងឈ្មោះបរទេសអំឡុងពេលបកប្រែ។

### ថ្មី
- កម្មវិធីទាញយកវីដេអូ內嵌 (Built-in Video Downloader) ដើម្បីទាញយកវីដេអូបុគ្គល ឆានែលពេញ ឬ បញ្ជីចាក់ ពី YouTube, TikTok, Facebook និងគេហទំព័រជាង ១,០០០ ទៀត (Pro)។
- ការរកឃើញសំឡេងក្មេងដោយស្វ័យប្រវត្តិ ជាមួយនឹងសំឡេងក្មេងប្រុស ក្មេងស្រី និងសំឡេងឌុបក្មេងៗថ្មី ដែលប្រើប្រាស់ឃ្លាភាសាខ្មែរដែលសبیសមស្របសម្រាប់ក្មេង។
- ការតភ្ជាប់ SvCamTool AI ដែលអនុញ្ញាតឱ្យអ្នកបកប្រែ និងរកឃើញសំឡេងដោយមិនចាំបាច់មានគន្លឹះ (key) Gemini ផ្ទាល់ខ្លួនរបស់អ្នក។
- កម្មវិធីបង្កើតរូបភាពតូច (Thumbnail Maker) ដែលបានពង្រីក ជាមួយនឹងរចនាប័ទ្មចំណងជើងជាង ១០០ ដែលត្រៀមរួចជាស្រេចដើម្បីប្រើប្រាស់ ការសម្គាល់ពាក្យ និងផ្លាកសញ្ញាភាគដែលអាចប្ដូរតាមបំណងបាន។
- ឧបករណ៍ពិនិត្យប្រព័ន្ធ (System Check) នៅក្នុងមីនុយជំនួយ ដើម្បីសាកល្បងអ៊ីនធឺណិត គន្លឹះ AI និងសេវាកម្មសំឡេងរបស់អ្នកភ្លាមៗចំពោះបញ្ហាផ្សេងៗ។
### បានកែលម្អ
- ការមើលជាមុននៃរចនាប័ទ្មចំណងជើងនៅក្នុង Thumbnail Maker ឥឡូវនេះបង្ហាញអត្ថបទពិតរបស់អ្នកជំនួសឱ្យអក្សរដាក់ជំនួសទូទៅ។
- កម្មវិធីតាមដានតូខេន (Token tracker) ក្រោម ជំនួយ > តូខេន AI របស់ខ្ញុំ ដើម្បីងាយស្រួលត្រួតពិនិត្យការប្រើប្រាស់ប្រចាំខែរបស់អ្នកពេលប្រើប្រាស់ SvCamTool AI។

### ថ្មី
- បានបន្ថែមផែនការ **Premium** ថ្មីដែលមានឧបករណ៍អ្នកបង្កើតកម្រិតខ្ពស់ [Premium]។
- បានបន្ថែមចំណងជើងរងមានចលនាពាក្យម្ដងៗ (ស្ទីលការ៉ាអូខេ និងផុបអាប់) [Premium]។
- បានបន្ថែម אפפקតពង្រីកស្វ័យប្រវត្តិនឹងបន្ទាត់សំខាន់ៗ [Premium]។
- បានបន្ថែមការគាំទ្រតន្ត្រីផ្ទៃខាងក្រោយជាមួយការបន្ថយសំឡេងស្វ័យប្រវត្តិពេលមានអ្នកនិយាយ [Premium]។
- បានបន្ថែមមុខងារក្លូនសំឡេង ដើម្បីឱ្យតួអង្គនីមួយៗរក្សាទុកសំឡេងដើមរបស់ខ្លួន [Premium]។
- បានបន្ថែមការនាំចេញពហុភាសា ដើម្បីបកប្រែ និង റെនដឺ វីដេអូជាច្រើនភាសា្នក្នុងពេលតែមួយ [Premium]។
- បានបន្ថែមការកាត់តស្វ័យប្រវត្តិ Shorts/Reels/TikTok និងការគាំទ្រថតឯកសារមើល [Premium]។
### បានកែលម្អ
- បានអាប់ដេតប្លង់អេក្រង់ទូទាត់ជាមួយការណែនាំច្បាស់លាស់ និងកម្មវិធីកំណត់ម៉ោងក្នុងប្រព័ន្ធ។
- បានកែលម្អការរាយការណ៍វឌ្ឍនភាពអំឡុងពេល រ៉េនដឺ តាមរយៈ FFmpeg និងការដំណើរការសំឡេង។

### ថ្មី
- បានបន្ថែមមុខងារបង្កើតរូបភាព AI សម្រាប់រូបភាពតូចៗ (Thumbnails) ដោយប្រើប្រាស់ Grok (xAI) ឬ ChatGPT (OpenAI) ជាមួយ API key ផ្ទាល់ខ្លួនរបស់អ្នក (សម្រាប់ Pro)។
- បានបន្ថែមបែបផែនអត្ថបទចលនា រួមមាន intro, outro និង loop effects សម្រាប់ស្រទាប់អត្ថបទផ្ទាល់ខ្លួន (សម្រាប់ Pro)។
- បានបន្ថែមស្រទាប់ចំណងជើងតូចបន្ថែម (ស្រទាប់អត្ថបទទីបី) សម្រាប់ការបង្កើតរូបភាពតូចៗ។

### แก้ไข

- เพิ่มข้อกำหนดและเงื่อนไขการชำระเงิน ซึ่งจะต้องกดยอมรับเมื่อซื้อไลเซนส์
### ปรับปรุง

- เพิ่มตัวเลือกภาษาการแสดงผลแอปสำหรับภาษาอังกฤษ เขมร ไทย และเวียดนาม

### ปรับปรุง

- คีย์ไลเซนส์ที่สร้างแบบออฟไลน์ได้รับการปกป้องจากการถูกเขียนทับโดยอัตโนมัติจากแผนระดับต่ำกว่า
- ตอนนี้ข้อผิดพลาดการเชื่อมต่อไลเซนส์จะแสดงในบันทึกหลักของแอปเพื่อให้แก้ไขปัญหาได้ง่ายขึ้น
### แก้ไข

### Mới
- Giờ đây bạn có thể mở trực tiếp các tệp video từ các ứng dụng khác trong hệ sinh thái Sv.
- Việc tạo giọng đọc lồng tiếng nay nhanh hơn nhờ tự động tái sử dụng các đoạn âm thanh đã tạo trước đó.
### Cải tiến
- Bản dịch nay ổn định hơn và xử lý mượt mà hơn nhiều trong thời điểm cao điểm.
- Ứng dụng giờ đây kiểm tra xem các thành phần lồng tiếng của bạn đã là phiên bản mới nhất chưa để đảm bảo hiệu suất tốt nhất.
- Quá trình xử lý video dài ổn định và hiệu quả hơn.
### Đã sửa lỗi
- Đã khắc phục các sự cố dịch vụ lồng tiếng thỉnh thoảng bị quá thời gian (timeout) hoặc dừng đột ngột.
- Cải thiện cách ứng dụng xử lý tên riêng nước ngoài trong quá trình dịch.

### Mới
- Tích hợp trình tải video để tải xuống video đơn, toàn bộ kênh hoặc danh sách phát từ YouTube, TikTok, Facebook và hơn 1.000 trang web khác (Pro).
- Tự động phát hiện giọng trẻ em với các giọng lồng tiếng bé trai, bé gái và trẻ em mới sử dụng cách diễn đạt tiếng Khmer thân thiện với trẻ nhỏ.
- Kết nối SvCamTool AI cho phép bạn dịch và phát hiện giọng nói mà không cần dùng khóa Gemini của riêng bạn.
- Trình tạo ảnh thu nhỏ (Thumbnail Maker) mở rộng với hơn 100 kiểu tiêu đề có sẵn, làm nổi bật từ và huy hiệu tập phim có thể tùy chỉnh.
- Công cụ kiểm tra hệ thống trong menu Trợ giúp để kiểm tra ngay lập tức kết nối internet, khóa AI và các dịch vụ giọng nói xem có lỗi gì không.
### Cải tiến
- Bản xem trước kiểu tiêu đề trong Trình tạo ảnh thu nhỏ giờ đây hiển thị văn bản thực tế của bạn thay vì các chữ cái giữ chỗ chung chung.
- Trình theo dõi token trong Trợ giúp > Token AI của tôi để dễ dàng theo dõi mức sử dụng hàng tháng của bạn khi dùng SvCamTool AI.

- Thêm phụ đề động theo từng từ (kiểu karaoke và pop-up) [Premium].
- Thêm hiệu ứng phóng to tự động (zoom) tại các câu quan trọng [Premium].
